claim.claim-text: a polynucleic acid up to 20 nucleotides in length, a charged moiety linked to a terminal nucleotide of the polynucleic acid, wherein the charged moiety comprises one of: at least two phosphates arranged in linear or branched configuration, and a sulfate.
2. The composition of Claim 1, wherein the charged moiety comprises at least two sulfates.
3. The composition of Claim 1, wherein the charged moiety comprises at least one phosphate and at least one sulfate.
4. The composition of any one of Claims 1-3, wherein the phosphates and/or sulfate(s) are disposed in linear or branched configuration.
5. The composition of Claim 4, wherein the phosphates and/or sulfate(s) are disposed in a branched configuration with two or more charged groups in each branch.
6. The composition of any one of Claims 1-5, wherein the charged moiety is linked to a 5' terminal nucleotide of the polynucleic acid.
7. The composition of any one of Claims 1-6, wherein the charged moiety is linked to a 3' terminal nucleotide of the polynucleic acid.
8. The composition of any one of Claims 1-7, wherein the polynucleic acid is configured to be ligated to a terminal end of a nucleic acid polymer analyte.
